plan: Since my value is $21, I should bid aggressively to try and win. I will bid $20.00. This ensures that if either of the other bidders have a value less than $20, I win. If either bidder has a value above $20, they will likely bid above $20, and I will lose. This is acceptable as the probability of winning with a bid higher than my value is low.

My value is $16. I want to avoid overbidding, which would lead to negative profit if I win. I also want to avoid underbidding, which would lead to missed opportunities to win with a positive profit. A reasonable strategy is to bid slightly below my value. I will bid $15.90. This allows me to win if others bid less than $15.90, and I will make a profit.

[I should bid less than my value to ensure a profit if I win. Bidding my value is weakly dominated. I will consider bidding a fraction of my value, say 80%, to balance the chance of winning with the potential profit margin. Given my value is $17, 80% of that is $13.6. I will bid $13.6. This leaves a good margin for profit and has a decent chance of winning.]
